label: Finding-44
title: offline-allies: The BBC capture does not make the claim the site marks 'contradicted'
description: BBC (06:30 post): 'The UK's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), as well as its counterparts in the EU and Australia, earlier urged those who use PHP to apply the fixes.' The offline sentence is then attributed to the NCSC only; the NSA appears in a separate post. The site's claim merges these into the BBC saying all four advise offline, and then marks that 'contradicted'. A reader is told the BBC was wrong about something it did not say.
